other_conditions: Can be issued to a manufacturer exporter or merchant exporter tied to a supporting manufacturer.
For pharmaceutical products manufactured through Non‑Infringing (NI) process, only manufacturer exporters are eligible.
Export obligation requires a minimum value addition of 15%.
Export obligation must be fulfilled within 18 months from the date of issue of the Authorisation.
Authorisation applies to physical export (including SEZ), intermediate supply, and supply of goods to specific categories as per FTP paragraphs 7.02(b)‑(g).
Supply of stores on board of foreign‑going vessel/aircraft is allowed only if specific Standard Input Output Norms exist for the item supplied.
benefits_summary: Input imports for export are exempted from customs duties, IGST and compensation cess, providing duty‑free access to required inputs.
